status: Source-only model-family gate; target artifacts remain closed.
claim_boundary: A passing result may admit only an exploratory five-case target-prefix gate. These targets have been examined previously and cannot establish an independent SOTA claim.
hypothesis: A canonical material-frame triplane model, meta-trained across source interactions and adapted through a low-dimensional latent on each held-out prefix, can transfer residual evolution that pooled world-frame MLP/GNN models miss.

information_boundary.meta_training: Complete registered outcomes may supervise only non-held-out source interactions.
information_boundary.heldout_adaptation: Only a case latent is optimized from held-out frames [0, fit_end). Global network weights remain fixed.
information_boundary.heldout_scoring: Each held-out source case is scored on [fit_end, train_end) after its prefix-only adaptation.
information_boundary.target_access: No target file, trajectory, observation, metric, checkpoint, or future artifact is read by this source gate.
information_boundary.prob4d: Prob4D is deferred until a dynamics family passes using trusted released residuals.

registered_motivation.neuspring: Canonical spatial spring fields outperform unstructured spring parameters in the published ablation.
registered_motivation.deformmaster: Its published particle-grid residual outperforms its MLP and three-round KNN-GNN residual controls.
registered_motivation.local_nulls: Shared linear, PGRD, and pooled graph-local MLP residual dynamics all failed transfer gates.

forbidden: opening target artifacts when the source gate fails
changing architecture, folds, seeds, blends, adaptation budget, or thresholds after source results
using held-out suffix frames to set velocity caps or adapt the case latent
calling a passing target-five result independent or state of the art
calling this implementation a reproduction of NeuSpring or DeformMaster
